items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That was taken at the Tulane Club, I guess. John Casimir. Who are the other guys? [INTERVIEWEE] He plays with Celestine.

ctx.x: Why are they so depressed like that? They couldn't make a bed and get a mattress or something.

Well, the D is blind and she's sick. Her mind is gone. She was in neurology at the Charity Hospital. All the doctors said what a brilliant woman she was. You know, to still retain everything she could. Now here, where is that? That was taken at the Tulane Club, I guess. John Casimir. Who are the other guys?
